units.source_text: 僧都等一行人在宇治院闭居了两天，替母尼僧和这个女子祈祷，诵念之声不绝。

en.t: The bishop and his party shut themselves up at the Uji temple for two days, praying for the mother nun and this young woman, while the sound of their chanting never ceased.

units.source_text: 同时人们纷纷议论这件怪事。

en.t: Meanwhile, people kept talking about this strange affair.

units.source_text: 住在这附近的乡人之中，有几个人从前曾在僧都处当过差，闻知僧都到此，都来访问，谈了许多话。

en.t: Among the villagers who lived nearby were several people who had once served under the bishop; when they heard that he had come here, they all came to visit and spoke at length.

units.source_text: 他们说：“已故八亲王家的女公子，和薰大将结了因缘，最近并无大病，突然亡故，大家都很惊骇。

en.t: They said, "The young lady of the late Eighth Prince's household had formed a bond with General Kaoru, and though she had not been seriously ill recently, she suddenly passed away, leaving everyone deeply shocked.

units.source_text: 我等要帮他们办理殡葬中的杂务，因此昨天不曾前来参见。”

en.t: We had to help them with the miscellaneous funeral arrangements, and so we were unable to come and pay our respects yesterday."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧闻之，想道：“如此说来，是鬼怪取了那女公子的灵魂而化作这个人的吧？”

en.t: When the younger nun heard this, she thought, "If that is so, could some spirit have taken that young lady's soul and transformed itself into this person?"

units.source_text: 便觉眼前这个人不是实体，是会消失的，心中不胜恐惧。

en.t: She then felt that the person before her was not a real, solid being, but something that might vanish, and her heart was filled with unbearable fear.

units.source_text: 侍女们说道：“昨夜这里也望见火光，这火葬仪式似乎并不隆重呢。”

en.t: The serving women said, "Last night we could see the firelight even from here; the cremation ceremony did not seem very grand."

units.source_text: 乡人答道：“是啊，他们故意从简，办得不很隆重。”

en.t: The villagers replied, "Yes, they deliberately kept it simple and did not make it very grand."

units.source_text: 乡人因为参与葬事，身子不洁，所以并不入内，交谈一会就回去了。

en.t: Because the villagers had taken part in the funeral rites and were ritually unclean, they did not go inside, but talked for a while and then left.

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“薰大将爱上八亲王家大女公子，但大女公子多年前早已死了。

en.t: The serving women said, "General Kaoru fell in love with the elder young lady of the Eighth Prince's household, but that lady died many years ago.

units.source_text: 刚才他们所说的女公子是谁呢？

en.t: Who was the young lady they were just talking about?

units.source_text: 薰大将已经娶了二公主，决不会另外爱上别的女子吧。”

en.t: General Kaoru has already married the Second Princess, so surely he would never fall in love with some other woman."
